label: Retrospective same-evidence vector comparison on the previously used controlled heldout cases; not a fresh confirmatory holdout
vector_store: QdrantClient(:memory:) local Qdrant vector collection, cosine distance
corpus: Only acquired evidence records with actual record payload in each adaptive v1 snapshot; one point per record, no graph links, gold, fault ID or private manifest
passage: passage: service {service_id without kind prefix} {operation}s configuration {config_key_id without kind prefix}
query: query: sorted failing public endpoint IDs, symptom codes and messages; no expected outcome
candidate_policy: Only public change targets within RECENT_WINDOW_MS; best cosine score among all acquired records matching each candidate; no document or result truncation at the observed corpus sizes
abstention: Insufficient evidence if no failing observation, no recent candidate, no acquired record or no matching record; ambiguous if top two candidate scores differ by at most 1e-6
scoring: Top-1 correct / all 36 cases per round across 3 seeds; abstentions and errors count noncorrect. Private expected ID is read only by outer scorer after vector prediction.
limitations: Existing heldout cases and acquired snapshots were already used for v1 evaluation; this is retrospective exploratory evidence only.

The comparator tests one local Qdrant collection, one published embedding model and one fixed text representation. It does not represent every possible vector architecture, hybrid retriever or tuned prompt.
The corpus contains only two or three acquired config-access records after round 0 and has a single small synthetic application topology.

The graph method and vector method use the same acquired evidence, but graph traversal uses the frozen topology and relationship semantics while this comparator ranks record text by cosine similarity.
Scores are measured on 12 controlled cases repeated across three acquisition seeds; this is not real incident or customer validation.
